mapper.select: select regnum,empnum,memnum,shnum,regcreated,regtime, lasttime,regdate,regupdatedat,regnote from registration order by regnum desc
select regnum, empnum, memnum, shnum, regcreated, regupdatedat, regnote from registration where regnum = #{regNum}
select regnum, empnum, memnum, shnum, regcreated, regupdatedat, regnote from registration where shnum = #{shNum}
mapper.insert: insert into registration ( empnum, memnum, shnum, regcreated, regupdatedat, regnote ) values ( #{empNum}, #{memNum}, #{shNum}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, #{regNote} )
mapper.update: update registration set empnum = #{empNum}, memnum = #{memNum}, shnum = #{shNum}, regtime = #{regTime}, lasttime = #{lastTime}, regdate = #{regDate}, regnote = #{regNote}, regupdatedat = current_timestamp where regnum = #{regNum}
